title: #142 Export invoices as CSV
summary: Add a button on the Invoices page that downloads the visible invoices as a CSV file. Only finance users should see it.

acceptance_criteria.text: Export button visible only for the finance role
CSV contains id, customer, amount, status, date

steps.text: Read OrderExport.ts to see how orders are exported today
Add the Export button with role check
Write unit tests for the CSV format

unclear.question: Should dates in the CSV be ISO (2026-10-22) or local (22.10.2026)?

images.alt: Screenshot of the Invoices table with an Export button drawn in red in the top-right corner.
